failures.status: Second reporter of the same auth failure, different words
failures.text: Three reporters, one failure, overlapping vocabulary. LABEL CORRECTED while authoring: the expectation was 'attached', but the two seed tickets do not clear the linkage threshold with each other, so no candidate exists for the arrival to join — verified by correlating the seed alone, independently of what the arrival then did. Grouping the arrival with the compatible seed ticket and forming a candidate is the correct outcome. The case still earns its place: it shows a candidate forming on the third report rather than the second.

notes: Authored online-intake cases: a window of tickets plus one arrival.
Eight cases. Acceptance and regression evidence, not a benchmark — no general claim should be drawn from a set this size.
False attachment is the metric that matters most: inventing an incident that is not happening is worse than missing one that is.
